summary.text: Half-life is the time it takes for a quantity to fall to half of its initial value, most often used for radioactive decay.
It also applies to exponential decay in general, such as the biological half-life of drugs and other chemicals in the human body.
For an exponentially decaying quantity the half-life is constant, and for a single atom it means a 50% chance of decaying within one half-life.

items.prompt: A decaying substance takes some number of days to fall from 100 grams to 50 grams. Compared with that, how long will it take to fall from 50 grams to 25 grams?

options.label: Half as long
Twice as long
The same length of time
Four times as long

items.explain: Half-life is constant over the lifetime of an exponentially decaying quantity.

items.prompt: A single radioactive atom has a half-life of one second. What does that tell you about it?

options.label: Exactly half the atom will be gone after one second
It has a 50% chance of decaying within one second
It will certainly decay at exactly one second
It will never decay after the first second

items.explain: For one atom the half-life is defined in terms of probability: a 50% chance of decaying within its half-life.

items.prompt: A huge number of identical atoms decay for one half-life. About how many remain?

options.label: Approximately half, though not exactly half
Exactly half every single time
None, since all of them must decay
About a tenth, then fewer over time

items.explain: Roughly half remain, not exactly, because of random variation, and with many atoms it is a very good approximation.

items.prompt: A quantity grows by a factor of 2 each period instead of shrinking. What is the matching idea to half-life called?

options.label: A decay constant
A doubling time
A steady state
A biological rate

items.explain: The converse of half-life is doubling time, an exponential property that increases by a factor of 2.

items.prompt: A drug has a biological half-life of 6 hours. What does that mean?

options.label: The body removes every trace within 6 hours
The drug works twice as strongly after 6 hours
Half the doses taken will fail within 6 hours
It takes 6 hours to lose half its activity

items.explain: A biological half-life is the time it takes for a substance to lose one-half of its pharmacologic, physiologic or radiological activity.

items.prompt: A quantity decays in a way that is nowhere near exponential. What happens to the time it takes to halve as the decay goes on?

options.label: It stays exactly the same throughout
It changes dramatically while the decay happens
It always doubles each time
It is zero for every stage

items.explain: In a decay process that is not close to exponential, the half-life changes dramatically during the decay.
